Tooltip_DanTraits_Inhaler:
Rescue inhaler.
Treats: asthma attacks and airway irritation.
Dose: one puff when your airway tightens. Works at once, halving the irritation.
Side effects: your heart races for a moment, and a diabetic's blood sugar rises a little.
10 puffs.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinPen:
Rapid-acting insulin.
Treats: diabetes (Type 1 needs it).
Dose: one dose lowers blood sugar by about 50 over four hours, starting after fifteen minutes.
Side effects: too much drops blood sugar dangerously low.
40 doses.
Tooltip_DanTraits_GlucoseMeter: Reads blood sugar from a drop of blood. Needs test strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_TestStrips: For a glucose meter. One strip per reading. 25 strips.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Metformin:
Daily diabetes pill.
Treats: Type 2 diabetes.
Dose: one pill a day. Builds up over 2 days, then lowers insulin resistance. Missed days let it fade.
Side effects: now and then, an upset stomach.
Too many at once: nausea.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_InsulinShort: Not enough left in the pen.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NotDiabetic: You have no reason to take this.
Tooltip_DanTraits_IronPills:
Iron supplement.
Treats: anaemia.
Dose: one a day to build your iron back up.
Side effects: now and then, mild nausea.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_NicotineGum:
Nicotine gum.
Treats: cigarette cravings (Smoker).
Dose: chew a piece when a craving hits. Takes most of the edge off at once. Quitting still takes three weeks without tobacco.
Side effects: none.
10 pieces.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Anticonvulsants:
Daily epilepsy pill.
Treats: epilepsy.
Dose: one pill every 12 hours. Builds up over 5 days, then makes seizures far less likely. Missed doses let it fade.
Side effects: now and then, drowsiness.
Too many at once: heavy and sluggish.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Sunblock: Rub it in and the sun can't burn bare skin for 8 hours. Does nothing for a burn you already have. 8 coats.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Diazepam:
Anti-anxiety pill.
Treats: panic and anxiety.
Dose: one pill calms panic quickly, for about an hour and a half.
Side effects: now and then, drowsiness.
Too many at once: you can barely keep your eyes open.
20 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillsBeta:
Daily heart pill.
Treats: Heart Condition.
Dose: one pill a day. Builds up over 3 days, then makes chest pain and heart attacks far less likely. Missed days let it fade. Does not calm panic (that is diazepam).
Side effects: now and then, stamina comes back slower.
Too many at once: dizziness and fainting.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_PillsAntiDep:
Daily antidepressant.
Treats: depression (Major Depressive Disorder). For anyone else, lifts mood over time.
Dose: one pill a day. Builds up over two weeks. Stopping suddenly after a week or more brings a few rough days.
Side effects: now and then, queasiness.
30 pills.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Painkillers:
Painkillers.
Treats: pain, including headaches, migraines, hangovers, gut flares and arthritis.
Dose: one or two pills. Work for a few hours. Taken early in a migraine, they also shorten it.
Side effects: none.
Tooltip_DanTraits_SleepingTablets:
Sleeping tablets.
Treats: trouble sleeping.
Dose: one at bedtime helps you fall asleep and sleep through light that would wake you.
Side effects: drowsiness.
Tooltip_DanTraits_Vitamins:
Caffeine pills.
Treats: tiredness.
Dose: one gives a burst of energy. Counts as caffeine, so it eases caffeine withdrawal.
Side effects: a little stress, and light wakes you more easily for a few hours.
